gcsimImport.title: Load from a gcsim config
gcsimImport.hint: Paste a gcsim config to load characters, constellations, weapons, refinements, artifact sets and the action sequence (the current party is replaced). Talent levels, stats, options and target are not loaded.
gcsimImport.noCharacters: No character in the app master data could be read from the config. (A `<key> char …;` line is required.)
gcsimImport.confirm:
Load "{{name}}" from the gcsim config. ({{chars}} characters, {{actions}} actions)
The current party will be replaced. Continue?
gcsimImport.ignoredIntro: These {{count}} items cannot be represented in the app (or are not supported), so they will not be loaded.

reason.energy: enemy particle (energy) settings are not loaded
reason.stats: stats are not supported yet (not loaded)
reason.talent: talent levels are not supported yet (not loaded)
reason.unknownCharacter: this character is not in the app master data
reason.unknownWeapon: this weapon is not in the app master data
reason.unknownArtifact: this artifact set is not in the app master data
reason.artifactCount: only 4-piece, or 2-piece + 2-piece, artifact sets can be loaded
reason.tooManyCharacters: characters beyond the 4th are not loaded
reason.unknownAction: the app character has no matching action
reason.paramsIgnored: parameters are not loaded; the basic action was used
reason.conditional: conditionals are not loaded (their contents were skipped)
reason.loopCondition: the loop condition was ignored; the body was loaded as one loop pass
reason.extraLoop: second and later loops are not loaded
reason.unknownStatement: this line could not be read
